issues.issue: Ecler is a concrete familiar filled choux pastry. Five recognizable incoming neighbors: Amandină, Savarină, Prăjitură, Vanilie and Ciocolată. Direct vanilla-pod cream and chocolate-cream variants are documented by JamilaCuisine; existing pastry relatives are honest cofetărie peers. The target has no exact record anywhere in the current pack. Neither yeast nor every possible flavor is claimed as necessary.

Amandină is a concrete familiar cocoa cake. Seven incoming neighbors include cocoa, chocolate, eclair, savarină, Joffre and two clear dessert/pastry categories. JamilaCuisine2013 and ProTV2016/2026 recipes document cocoa sponge/cream and chocolate glaze variants. No origin, universal alcohol ingredient or mandatory chocolate-glaze claim is introduced.

Halva is a familiar confection with seed-based variants. Five incoming neighbors are cocoa, sunflower seeds, Baclava dobrogeană, Mâncare de post and Dulce. Feleacul lists actual sunflower/cocoa formulations; Romanian Wikipedia and Radio Romania show sustained domestic culinary presence. Not every halva is sunflower-based, and the variant edges say so.

Înghețată is an ordinary concrete frozen dessert. Six incoming neighbors include vanilla, cocoa, milk, fistic, dessert and crepes. Named recipes use vanilla/cocoa flavors and milk; a manufacturer recipe explicitly serves ice cream with crepes. Non-dairy or non-cocoa variants remain valid; the graph does not claim all preparations use every ingredient.

Stafide→Brânză has exactly two shortest routes: Stafide→Pască→Brânză and Stafide→Poale-n brâu→Brânză. Both documented sweet-cheese recipes include raisins; these are ingredient-to-preparation-to-ingredient associations, not a physical transformation of raisins into cheese. Exact endpoints are new in the current pack; both routes have different first hops and no intermediate choke.
